turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have until then. Owen saw a zero on his phone in the middle of class and nobody called me first, so start there: who decided, and when?
I'm sitting. I asked you who entered that zero, and whether anyone spoke to Owen before it went in.
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
Don't manage me, Hale. The only call that mattered was the one before the zero went in, and nobody made it. Who decided?
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.
No. "Move on" is what you do after you've checked the evidence, and you haven't shown me any. Either the zero comes off, or I walk down to the principal's office when we're done here.
